runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: Diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Sluzby zamestnanosti, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new candidate cleared promotion quality. Wolt Support Associate is genuinely fresh and Bratislava/remote but requires English B2 and rotating mornings/evenings/weekends for 1270 EUR, so it is not a priority fit. Snooti IKT sales support is local and administratively relevant but only 1150 EUR and needs deeper requirement verification. Fresh Upwork Shopify support is remote but only $5/h with 50+ proposals. LIVE jobs-data remains fail-closed because safe complete round-trip replacement is unavailable.

developmentChanges.title: Fresh-role application window
developmentChanges.reason: Track first-seen time separately from publishedAt and boost verified roles during the first 6/12/24 hours, especially when applicant counts are still low. This focuses reaction effort where timing can materially improve interview probability.

developmentChanges.title: Shift/pay friction index
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize salary against evenings, weekends, night coverage and rotating schedules so superficially relevant support roles are automatically deprioritized when schedule burden is high relative to compensation.
